metadata.method: WebUI performance.mark / performance.measure + rAF sampler via window.__nanobotPerf (gated by localStorage.nanobot_perf_record = '1')
metadata.note: Client-side WebUI marks are wired in main.tsx and ThreadShell. To record metrics in installed desktop app or dev server: set localStorage.setItem('nanobot_perf_record', '1'), reload, and run window.__nanobotPerf.dump(). Click-to-splash and click-to-chrome start from OS process spawn, while navigation-based chrome time is measured from webui_index_exec to webui_shell_mount_ms.

manual_collection_instructions.measure_scroll: window.__nanobotPerf.startFpsSampling(); /* cuộn danh sách 300 tin */ window.__nanobotPerf.stopFpsSampling();
